May 19, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Saturna Capital Corp decreased its stake in Facebook Class A (FB) by 31.66% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Saturna Capital Corp sold 5,792 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 12,501 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.21 million, down from 18,293 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Saturna Capital Corp who had been investing in Facebook Class A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $528.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.59% or $1.08 $182.68. About 10.38M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
